about.body: The AJ200P is Jaguar Land Rover's higher-output 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine from the Ingenium family, introduced a year after the diesel AJ200D. It's fitted across two Jaguar model lines — the F-Pace SUV and the XE saloon — in both 250 and 300 horsepower configurations.

byModel.body: The AJ200P appears in two Jaguar model lines. In the F-Pace (X761, 2016–present), it powers the P250 and P300 variants. In the XE (X760, 2016–present), it powers the P250 and P300 variants. These are the only Jaguar applications for this engine code — each with its own vehicle-specific ancillaries.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ200P spans two different models and two power output levels, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec — which we do by registration. An AJ200P from an F-Pace isn't a drop-in match for an AJ200P from an XE, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries and mounting differ. Full engine replacements require DME software matching.
